description: NV-ODMR coil calibration B = M @ I + B0 (black_diamond setup). B: field at the NV ensemble in the NV quantization frame (frame of quantization_axes; x, y, z closest to the X, Y, Z coil axes), as gamma*B in MHz. I: PHYSICAL coil currents in A (see relay_note).
fit: joint fit of one linear model to 48 raw 1001-point spectra (all CoilSuperposition points + the mixed CoilLinearity points; 8 Lorentzian dips each, free amplitude/width per dip, D global), soft-L1 loss. Uncertainties: delete-one-current jackknife of a line-frequency fit, plus the difference between the two fit methods, in quadrature.

validation.model: linear; quadratic, cubic and bilinear cross terms all predict held-out spectra worse (8-fold CV)
validation.single_coil_note: single-coil fields leave two NV axes nearly perpendicular to B; their strain-affected central lines are not described by the E = 0 Hamiltonian, hence not used in the fit
validation.oct2_note: 9 points of 2026-10-02 (200-pt, MW 0.2, incl. 3 at Z = +-3.27 A); the same dips measured on both days differ by 3.3 MHz rms, i.e. the limit is the old data
validation.repeatability: 8 runs at (-3.26, -3, -1.86) A over 8.8 h: line std 0.35 MHz
validation.hysteresis_remanence: none above 0.6 MHz (return points, zero-current spectra before/after each scan)
validation.all_spectra_cross_check: joint fit to all 82 spectra with |B| > 32 G (single-coil scans included, central lines of near-perpendicular axes masked): every M entry within 0.06 MHz/A, B0 within 0.14 MHz, D 2871.18 MHz

relay_note: During the calibration runs (2026-10-04/05) the polarity relay commanded as X reversed the Y coil and vice versa (coil_control config: psu_x/psu_y cross-connected, switch_names x: X, y: Y); the fit uses the physical currents (|I_X| * relay_Y, |I_Y| * relay_X, I_Z). switch_names was changed to x: Y, y: X on 2026-10-05: from then on commanded currents = physical currents, and this calibration applies to the setpoints directly.
symmetry_note: ODMR spectra are invariant under the 48 NV-axis symmetries; M and B0 are the representative whose coil directions are closest to nominal x, y, z.
